gaps.description: The archive request from DRAFT specifies unchanged state but does not specify persisted-data or other side-effect behavior.
gaps.impact: Only the preserved DRAFT state has a sourced oracle for this request.
gaps.needed_evidence: A requirement specifying persisted-data and side-effect expectations for undefined events.

gaps.description: Failure atomicity for submission, submitted_at value semantics, and event behavior from CANCELLED are unspecified.
gaps.impact: Failure-path, timestamp-value, and additional transition oracles remain unassessed.
gaps.needed_evidence: Submission failure and timestamp contracts, plus event rules for CANCELLED.

findings.impact: Submission state or timestamp persistence could diverge from the model.
findings.reachability: Pre-state is initial; target is reachable by this transition.
findings.validation_method: In future validation, submit as owner from DRAFT and inspect SUBMITTED state and persisted submitted_at; exact timestamp semantics remain unspecified.

findings.impact: Cancellation could produce the wrong state or unintended side effects.
findings.reachability: Pre-state is initial; target is reachable by this transition.
findings.validation_method: In future validation, cancel from DRAFT and compare state and side-effect observations with the stated oracle.

findings.impact: Invalid cancellation could mutate terminal state or persisted data.
findings.reachability: Pre-state is reachable through submit from DRAFT with owner=true.
findings.validation_method: In future validation, establish SUBMITTED, snapshot persisted data, request cancel and compare state and data with the snapshot.

findings.guard: archive is not a defined event.
findings.impact: An undefined request could incorrectly change state; persisted-data behavior lacks an oracle.
findings.side_effect_expectation: Unspecified beyond unchanged state; see G-STT-001.
findings.validation_method: In future validation, request archive from DRAFT and inspect unchanged state. Clarify side-effect requirements before asserting a persisted-data outcome.

findings.impact: A false ownership guard could incorrectly permit submission or mutate persisted data.
findings.validation_method: In future validation, snapshot DRAFT and persisted data, submit with owner=false and compare state and data with the snapshot.

candidate_recommendations.residual_risk: Unspecified transitions and failure behavior remain unassessed; candidate selection provides no runtime coverage evidence.

shared_context.close_condition: Future validation records pre-state, request, post-state and relevant persisted-data observations against each sourced oracle.
shared_context.minimum_evidence: Referenced model facts support design expectations only.
shared_context.owner_role: Proposed: QA designer for validation; requirements owner for missing oracles.
shared_context.scope: Supplied submission and cancellation model; version unspecified.
shared_context.selection: Retain all five explicitly specified transitions. Do not infer additional event outcomes.

evidence_backed_inferences.statement: SUBMITTED is reachable from initial DRAFT by submit with owner=true; CANCELLED is reachable by cancel.
The owner=true and owner=false submission candidates exercise both stated guard outcomes.

facts.objective: Select sourced valid and invalid transitions with state and side-effect oracles.

pending: Requirements owner clarification of G-STT-001 and G-STT-002.

summary: Draft design with two valid and three invalid transition candidates derived from the supplied model. No tests were executed.
